title: The Chest of Tranquillity
art: The prophet of the Children of Israel in Talut's time is named Shamwil (Samuel) in the commentaries; he and the people appear only as lights. The angels who carried the chest are columns of light (2:248). The chest's relics are not shown.
imagePrompt: A hill town in the land of Israel at morning, crowds of dim lights gathered before a steady light, murmuring against a tall plain figure of light chosen as king; then columns of soft golden light coming over the hill bearing a gilded chest on poles, and setting it down before the people; ink-wash and parchment texture.

beats.say: Long after Musa, the Children of Israel asked their prophet for a king to lead them in God's cause, and God chose Talut. How can he be king over us, they objected, when he has no great wealth?

God chose him and gave him knowledge and strength, their prophet said, and here is the sign: the chest will come to you, carried by angels, bringing tranquillity from your Lord and what was left by the families of Musa and Harun.

verse.en: And their prophet said to them, "Indeed, a sign of his kingship is that the chest will come to you in which is assurance from your Lord and a remnant of what the family of Moses and the family of Aaron had left, carried by the angels. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers."
